Commentary.Commentary: Windies also have some good pacers in their ranks but the Bangladesh batting line-up is also a good one. We could be in for a very good chase here.
262 is the target now! The surface is a decent one to bat on but there is some assistance for the bowlers.

The Bangladesh bowlers weren't quite effective with the new ball. However, their spinners made life difficult for the Windies. The two had combined figures of 20-0-71-2. Mashrafe and Saifuddin were brilliant in the death, the former especially as he finished with a three-fer. However, Rahman took a real pounding today. Had he bowled well, they could have restricted them to a lower total.

An excellent comeback from Bangladesh! They will surely be the happier team walking off the field at the moment. However, it was the Windies who were looking in control till the 40th over courtesy, their openers first who stitched a 89-run stand. They did lose Ambris and Bravo quickly but then Chase and Hope not only got them back on track but when the two were batting, 300 looked possible. Once the former fell though, the Windies completely lost their way. From 205 for 2 they ended up being 219 for 6. A handy innings from Nurse though, took them to a competitive total.
Length delivery on middle, Cottrell flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. WEST INDIES FINISH THEIR INNINGS WITH 261/9.
OUT! Nurse departs! Full toss on middle, Nurse lofts it over mid on but does not get the distance on it. It goes towards long on where Sabbir Rahman takes a good catch sliding forward.
Just a couple from the Free Hit! Full and on middle, this is worked towards deep mid-wicket and the batsmen take two.
NO BALL! A high full toss outside off, Roach looks to throw his bat at it but misses. Rahim fails to collect it cleanly and the batsmen run a bye. A much-needed Free Hit coming up for the Windies.
Full on leg, Cottrell lofts it over mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Play and a miss! On a good length and outside off, Cottrell looks to slog but gets beaten on this one.
Length delivery on leg, Nurse flicks it through square leg for a run.
A dot to end an excellent penultimate over! Just the three runs and a wicket from it. A yorker to finish on off, Cottrell jams it out towards point.
A high full toss, Nurse is caught by surprise, he eases it down to long on for a run.
A little too straight, this is worked towards fine leg for a single.
On a length and around off, Sheldon pushes it back to the bowler.
OUT! KABOOM! Too quick for Roach! Saifuddin gets his second. He delivers a low full toss on middle, Roach fails to get his bat down in time and the middle stump is uprooted.
Good fielding! Shorter in length and on middle, Nurse pulls it to the right of deep mid-wicket. Sarkar there runs to his right and does well to push it back in. Saves 3 for his side.
Full toss on middle, Ashley lofts it over mid on. The batsmen take a single. 10 runs and a wicket from the over. Big over for West Indies.
Full on middle, Nurse lofts it over mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.

Kemar Roach is the new batsman in.

OUT! That is an absolute blinder by Shakib. Carter can consider himself really unfortunate here. He has creamed that, just creamed it. No way he would have thought, he is going to be dismissed when he connected. He takes a few steps down and whips it right off the middle. It goes flat and towards wide long on. Shakib at long on runs to his left and then takes it with a full stretch dive to his left. Carter trudges off slowly and the last recognized batsman for the Windies is out of here.

He is hurried into the shot and only manages to hit it high up in the air towards Soumya Sarkar at deep square leg who takes the simplest of catches. The Windies seem to be losing their way here.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back for his final spell.

Holder looks to push it on the off side but gets an outside edge which goes to the keeper. Mushfiqur Rahim behind the stump fumbles but manages to hold onto the catch. Second wicket in the over for Mortaza. With two new men at the crease, Bangladesh would look to pounce on this opportunity and try to restrict them under 260.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short delivery on middle, Holder pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

OUT! Both the set batsmen are gone. This is a big wicket for Bangladesh in the context of the game. Length delivery outside off, Hope tries to loft it over covers but does not get the timing on it. Shorter outside off, Hope punches it to deep cover and keeps the strike.

FIFTY for Shai Hope. His 9th ODI fifty  in ODI and second consecutive one in the series. He gets to the milestone with a gentle push towards cover. West Indies will hope that he can continue and turn it into another one.

OUT! Darren Bravo has to depart. Two wickets in quick succession for Shakib Al Hasan. Shakib tosses it up just outside off, Bravo looks to defend but gets an outside edge. Rahim appeals for caught behind and the umpire raises his finger. However, Darren Bravo is not happy with the decision and is walking off. Replays are inconclusive. Bangladesh are making a strong comeback.
Tossed up on off, Bravo looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show there is an inside edge on it.

Dot to finish the over. Flatter on off, Hope defends it off his front foot. Excellent comeback from Mehidy. After getting hit for a boundary he has picked up a wicket and given away just a single off the remaining 5.

Darren Bravo is the new batsman in.

OUT! Stunning, absolutely stunning catch from Mahmudullah! Bangladesh needed something special to break this partnership and they have got it. Floated on off, it was a nothing delivery to be fair. Ambris comes down the track and looks to hit it over cover but Mahmudullah jumps and grabs the ball out of thin air. Mehidy strikes straightaway. Just the kind of impact Mortaza would have wanted Mehidy to make.
FOUR! That is potentially the worst start for any bowler. Shorter on off, Ambris gets on his back foot and smashes it through covers for a boundary. Not the start Mehidy would have wanted.

Drinks Break! West Indies are going at a good rate and both the openers have done well till now. They will look to carry on. On the other hand, Bangladesh  have tried to keep it tight and will look to break this partnership. Also, Mehidy Hasan to bowl after the break.
Oh, close! Tossed up on middle, Sunil comes down the track but misses the ball and gets an inside edge. The ball hits the keeper on the pads and goes to the on side. They run through for a single.
FOUR! Deft touch! Shorter on off, Ambris waits for it and then taps it fine down the third man region for a boundary.

Rahman changes his line, bowls this outside off. Ambris taps it towards the third man region for a run.

The umpire is happy with Saifuddin's effort and he saves two for his side.

Short delivery on middle, Hope pulls it to mid-wicket.
Short of a length delivery, Ambris looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes between mid-wicket and mid on. It lands safely in no man's land. The batsmen cross ends.
On a good length on leg, Ambris looks to pull but misses it and gets hit high on the pads. Mortaza appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Probably height is the factor there.
Length delivery on off, Hope guides it towards third man for a run.
Length delivery on off, Hope plays it to point.
Fuller on off, angling away slightly after pitching. Ambris looks to defend but it goes off the outer half of his bat to point.
Outside off, Ambris dabs it down wide of third man and gets a couple.
Back of a length ball on off, Ambris gets on his back foot and blocks it.
Once again outside off and closer to the stumps, Ambris shoulders arms to it.
Length ball outside off, Ambris runs it down wide of third man and gets a couple.
Better this from Saifuddin. On the fourth stump line, Ambris though calmly leaves it alone.
WIDE! Bowls it on a length outside off. Saifuddin looks to stretch Ambris but it's way outside off. The umpire signals it as wide as it was outside the tramline.
Full on off, Hope drives it back towards the bowler.
Length delivery on middle, Hope nudges it to the leg side.
Mortaza bowls it on off, Shai blocks it off the back foot.
Good length delivery on middle, Hope tucks it to mid-wicket.
On middle, Ambris flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a length on middle, Ambris flicks it to mid-wicket.
On off, Hope defends it out. Maiden over from Saifuddin. This is tight bowling from him. Good comeback from the bowler as he had gone for 8 runs in his first over.
Length delivery on middle, Hope blocks it well.
Fourth consecutive leave for Shai Hope. Outside off, Shai leaves it alone.
On a good length and outside off, Hope does not bother to play at that.
Second consecutive leave from Shai Hope. On a good length and outside off, Hope offers no shot to this one.
Bowls it wide outside off, Hope lets it go.
Good length delivery on off, Hope defends it towards point and takes a single.
Good length delivery on leg, Ambris looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The batsmen take a run. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.
On a good length on off, Sunil looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes towards first slip where it falls short of the fielder.
Good length delivery on off, Ambris keeps it out.

APPEAL FOR LBW! NOT OUT! On a good length on off, Ambris looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Bangladesh think of the review but decide against it.

On a good length on leg, Ambris looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. Mortaza appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head.  Bangladesh think of the review but decide against it.Probably it is sliding down leg and height might be the factor as well as it hit him above the knee roll.
Skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza to bowl from the other end.
Good length delivery on middle, Hope gets on his back foot and blocks it. Solid start for Shai Hope and West Indies.
On a good length on off, Hope keeps it out.
Saifuddin once again pulls his length back and bowls it outside off. Shai leaves it alone.

FOUR! Nice shot. Saifuddin delivers this full on off. This time Hope obliges to drive, as it is in his zone. It comes right off the middle of the bat and goes through covers for a boundary. No chance stopping that.
Better from Saifuddin. Corrects his line and bowls it on a length outside off, tempting Hope to drive but Shai does not fall into the trap and calmly leaves it alone.

FOUR! What a start! First ball of the game and it has been dispatched to the boundary. Saifuddin starts with a length delivery on middle, Hope, who is in amazing form does not take time to settle and wonderfully flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

Done and dusted with the national anthems. We are all set to begin. The players and umpires are out in the middle. Shai Hope and Sunil Ambris will open the batting for the West Indies. Mohammad Saifuddin will start the proceedings for Bangladesh.
The players walk out in the middle for their respective national anthems. Just before the national anthem, Shane Dowrich got his maiden ODI cap handed to him by West Indies skipper, Jason Holder.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza says they would have batted first as well as it is a used pitch. Tells they have to start well and need to comeback strongly. He further adds that West Indies play fast and they have to play well.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder says this is a used wicket and hence he wants to bat. He says that the openers played well in the last game and hopes the good performance continue. Tells the boys are in good spirit and there are young guys who have hardly played ODI and they have a chance to prove themselves. Informs John Campbell has a sore back so he misses out and Shane Dowrich comes in his place.
Toss - Up goes the coin and falls in the favor of West Indies. West Indies opt to bat first.

Welcome to match 2 of this Tri-Nation series. Today West Indies go up against Bangladesh. This will be the real test for this slightly weak West Indian side. Their inexperienced batting line up will be tested against a full strength Bangladesh side. Mortaza and his men will like to start their preparation for the World Cup strongly and get their campaign off with a win. Rain can play a spoil-sport in this fixture but let's hope we get a full game like the previous one. A big clash awaits us. Stay tuned for updates.
